training.estimator: PerformanceModel, group-weighted Bayesian mixture response surface
training.population_utility: E[0.5*transmission + 0.5*toughness/(toughness+5)] on a successful fresh preparation, excluding meter error

assumptions: The balanced prior describes the population after enrollment with an accepted reference specimen.
A stock assay observes one noisy reading; only its band enters the policy.
The archived specimen retains its preparation offset on rereading. A fresh make draws a new offset.
The synthetic lab uses its own population response equations. The policy's scenario responses come from the fitted historical surrogate, with declared make-failure and instrument noise models.
description: Two formulations share an incoming stock lot. The binder-rich recipe uses 75% of it; the binder-lean recipe uses 15%. The carrier is 4 Pa s. A paid viscometer assay reports whether the stock reads below or above 4 Pa s.
